Puzru uses a quiet notification to show when it is on and ready to route audio, including while the app is in the background. Notifications are optional; Puzru still works without them.

مینی needs Android’s “Display over other apps” access to stay visible while you use a supported voice app. This access is optional and does not let Puzru read or control other apps. Audio routing works without مینی.
